eyebrow: Docker & Deployment for AI Applications · Chapter Three
subtitle: Lesson 14 · Deployment Patterns

code:
BLUE  (currently live)   <- 100% of traffic
GREEN (new version)      <- 0% of traffic, deployed, warmed up

Switch at the gateway (Lesson 13):
  BLUE  <- 0% traffic
  GREEN <- 100% traffic   (instant cutover)
caption: The cutover is a routing change, not a redeploy -- which is what makes it near-instant.

eyebrow: What it costs, what it buys
code:
Cost: BOTH environments run at full capacity
      during the overlap (double the compute)

Buys: zero-downtime switch, and a bad release
      is undone by routing back, not a redeploy
caption: For GPU-backed inference containers, that doubled cost is real, not a rounding error.

code:
Plain web app smoke test:
  GET /health -> 200 OK   (usually enough)

AI app verification:
  GET /health -> 200 OK   (necessary, not sufficient)
  run known test prompts through green
  compare outputs to blue's known-good results
caption: A green service that's "up" but serving a different model is a worse failure than an outage.
